title: Lila and the Blue Creek Cup
youtube_title: Lila and the Blue Creek Cup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness means returning what you find, even when you wish you could keep it for a little while.
summary: Lila finds a painted cup by the creek and wants to use it as a harbor for her leaf boat, then walks it back to the neighbor boy who lost it and shares the slow pool instead.
